items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: And there was men in the band like Greely Walton; there was Jonas Walker, trombone... I think Jonas Walker left the band.

ctx.x: Oh, no. We hadn't been there... We weren't there all that time. No, we only played there a few weeks, I don't know how many weeks, and then we came out of there and we came back to the Savoy. See, we had come back to New York to the Savoy -- in New York here. And I think that's when Ken Kersey left the band... But see, they was always getting changes in the band. And I think Jonas Walker left the band. And of course, Bud Powell taken Ken Kersey's place. I don't know if he taken Ken Kersey's place or not, but...…

But Bud was the greatest of them all, Bud Powell -- and he was a genius. He was really a genius. He was about 17 years old when he come into Cootie's band. And he was a kid, and we was sittin' up there rehearsing. So Cootie's rehearsing this theme song for Bud; you know, so Bud can see how it goes.
